tools.name: get_post_tags
tools.description: **[REAL-TIME API]** Extract all tags from a specific Danbooru post by ID or URL by querying Danbooru API directly. Use this when: - You want to get ALL tags from a single post in real-time - You need tag categories and counts for a specific post For analyzing tag statistics across multiple posts, use 'get_character_tags'.

params.name: post_id_or_url
params.description: Danbooru post ID (number) or URL (e.g., https://danbooru.donmai.us/posts/2973340)

tools.name: get_character_tags
tools.description: **[REAL-TIME API]** Analyze frequently used tags for a character by querying Danbooru API directly in real-time with advanced filtering options. Use this when: - You need the LATEST, most up-to-date tag statistics - The character data is NOT yet saved in the database - You want quick exploration without saving data - You need filtered analysis (clothing only, specific categories, include/exclude tags) For analyzing SAVED data, use Turso SQL tools instead. For bulk data collection to save, use 'c

params.name: top_n
params.description: Number of top tags to return (default: 50)

params.name: num_posts
params.description: Number of posts to analyze (default: 100, no limit)

params.name: character_tag
params.description: Character tag to search (e.g., hatsune_miku, crimson_avenger_(elsword))

tools.name: get_wiki_info
tools.description: **[REAL-TIME API]** Search Danbooru Wiki for tag/character information in real-time. Use this when: - You need information about what a tag means - You want to understand tag relationships or aliases - You need character background or copyright info

params.name: tag_name
params.description: Tag name to search (e.g., hatsune_miku, tachi-e)

tools.name: get_post_count
tools.description: **[REAL-TIME API]** Get the total number of posts for a specific tag. Use this when: - You want to know how many posts exist for a character/tag BEFORE collecting data - You need to estimate collection time and resources - You want to verify data completeness after collection Returns only the post count. Use danbooru-turso-mcp.collect_and_save for actual data collection.

params.name: tag
params.description: Tag to check post count (e.g., scathach_(fate), hatsune_miku)
